_source: Hand-written to the Messages API response shape (content blocks, stop_reason, usage); not captured from the live API. Boats, counts and conditions are made up.
description: What's biting: get_port_report (TA-E2) on the committed daily-feed fixture: no skipper reports yet, the landing's Starfire trip with its Low label; the reply cites the landing and links the port. message: What's been biting out of Morro Bay, any lingcod?

tool_result_contains: No skipper reports from the last three days. The landing reports 1 trip with rockfish and lingcod this week; recent reported activity: Low.

content.text: No skipper reports out of Morro Bay in the last two weeks yet. The landing reported Starfire on Sun Sep 27: copper rockfish and bocaccio for 28 anglers, plus 8 lingcod. Recent reported activity: Low. Full picture: {{link:port:morro-bay}}
